The '''2013–14 Virginia Tech Hokies men's basketball team''' represented [[Virginia Polytechnic Institute and State University]] during the [[2013–14 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. They were led by second year head coach [[James Johnson (basketball coach)|James Johnson]] and played their home games at [[Cassell Coliseum]]. They were a member of the [[Atlantic Coast Conference]]. They finished the season 9–22, 2–16 in ACC play to finish in last place. They lost in the first round of the [[2014 ACC men's basketball tournament|ACC tournament]] to Miami (FL).

On March 17, head coach James Johnson was fired.<ref>{{cite news|url= https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/26429544/texas-hires-va-tech-williams-coach|title= James Johnson out at Virginia Tech |first=Jeff|last=Goodman|work=[[ESPN]]|date=March 17, 2014|access-date=March 1, 2024}}</ref> He compiled a record of 22–41 in two seasons. On March 21, he was replaced by [[Buzz Williams]], most recently the head coach at [[Marquette Golden Eagles men's basketball|Marquette]].
